content: 1. Haloperidol enhances the effects of hyoscyamine spray through pharmacodynamic synergy. Close monitoring is advised. 2. Hyoscyamine spray reduces haloperidol levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction is relevant only for the oral forms of both drugs. 3. Hyoscyamine spray also decreases haloperidol levels via pharmacodynamic antagonism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. 4.
